newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM gold futures soften, platinum group mixed.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM gold futures soften, platinum group mixed.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold futures ended weaker across the board on Friday after drifting sideways, while platinum group metals were mixed in directionless activity, traders said.
Gold futures ranged from three yen to eight yen per gram lower. Newly listed benchmark April ended flat at 1,371 yen.
Private investors were mostly sidelined ahead of the Group of Seven (G7) meeting over the weekend, watching to see how the dollar reacts afterwards.
Spot gold was quoted at $340.60/341.00 per ounce, against $340.50/341.00 in New York on Thursday.
